title: A double-quoted escape naming a lone surrogate code point
notes: Production [60] ns-esc-16-bit escapes a 16-bit Unicode character, and a surrogate code point (xD800 to xDFFF) is not a character: c-printable [1] excludes it, so the escape names no character and is an error. Loose mode needs any error; strict needs the syntax category. This case says nothing about an escaped surrogate pair: a lone surrogate is refused whatever a library does with pairs.

provenance.reference: A decoder that turned a \u escape of a lone surrogate into a value (an invalid string or a replacement character) instead of refusing the escape.
